coordinateFrame: Equatorial J2000, raDeg and decDeg in degrees. All distances light-years. No proper motion propagation.

selection.brightness: Apparent Johnson V magnitude as seen from Earth; smaller number is brighter; not absolute luminosity.
selection.namedScope: All current IAU WGSN CSN names plus HYG traditional proper names and curated named deep-sky landmarks. Not every informal name ever used.
selection.unresolvedDistances: Objects remain searchable but not navigable. HYG sentinel100000pc is never treated as a physical distance.
selection.namedDeepSky: All OpenNGC Common names (132 rows) plus familiar M101; original famous landmarks retained; arbitrary nearest ATNF and numbered-galaxy filler removed.

curatedCosmicLandmarks.references: Individual source URLs, position assumptions, extent definitions and candidate status retained per record.
curatedCosmicLandmarks.distance: Present-epoch comoving distance integrated from redshift in common flat LCDM H0=70, OmegaM=0.3, OmegaLambda=0.7; radiation neglected. Light-travel time is separately integrated, never used as distance.
curatedCosmicLandmarks.nearbyVoid: Local Void anchor: Cosmicflows-3 Lacerta-2.4 SG XYZ=(22,-9,22) Mpc, transformed using the Lahav/de Vaucouleurs supergalactic basis.
curatedCosmicLandmarks.display: Illustrative contours; widths or central directions without measured footprints are explicitly identified. No decorative filler.

fullCatalog.search: Lazy 19.2 MB compact worker index; 100 results initially
fullCatalog.map: One spatial binary tree (no radial bands); max256 leaf rows, 48 cached tiles, 32 view nodes, 4 concurrent loads, 8000 streamed points
fullCatalog.uncertainty: Formal policy v2: bounded point estimates only; no sentinels or model bounds. Field reported relative error <=0.5, ATNF PX significance >3 and DM-model ratio <=2. Host-local model envelope <=0.5 of its reference diameter; common host-distance error is correlated, not independent scatter. Full definitions in docs/catalog.md.
fullCatalog.systems: 461 catalog groups; shared-distance estimates explicitly labelled. Distance conflicts suppress orbital diagrams; Cygnus X-1/HDE226868 use the published system distance. Local shared display transform prevents t-SNE separation of close components.
fullCatalog.fictionalStars: Known nearby stars preferred; otherwise explicitly fictional departure stars at every mapped destination, persisted with expedition.

nearbyGalaxyStars.distance: M31 V1/AF: inclined-disk ray intersection. R136a1/HD5980: common host distance, unresolved depth.

fullCatalog.confirmedSystems: data-tools/confirmed-systems.json: published physical relationships override conflicting individual distance estimates; common distances remain explicitly approximate.

galaxyMembers.selection: LGGS Mm=1; PHAT main table2 only; M33 SNR Conf=yes
galaxyMembers.model: Measured directions; disk-ray intersections for massive stars/gas; host-depth envelope for unaged PHAT clusters; M33 mirror ambiguity included.
